value.rationale: A canonical nonfinite-rank Hilbert matrix family has a sharp compactness threshold. Proving every compact member is actually Hilbert–Schmidt, while giving a full harmonic trace and exact first-order singularity of Tr(H*H), determines nontrivial operator-ideal invariants naturally motivated by this threshold; it is not an arbitrary finite experiment or only a small numerical gain.
